apps.localizedDescription: NBA 2K15 – improved release of the popular basketball simulator. Developers from 2K Sports tried their best – compared with the previous version, and improved physics and graphics, and even the intellect of rivals, and this makes the game even more attractive. So, the new Euroleague teams are waiting for their intense games within the framework of the League of Peace. Chicago Bulls, Miami Heat, Los Angeles Lakers and other basketball players are ready right now to fight with you for the title of the best of the best! The career mode will open doors for you to a great basketball! Compete with multiplayer and become the number one!
